## Evidence-gated Pull Request

**Source / venture / explicit owner:** 

**Change and why:** 

**Upstream source and version/SHA / full licence, including transitives:** 

**R0 spend and network/API scope:** 

**Tests at exact HEAD (URL / commit):** 

**Browser/physical Safari, accessibility and privacy checks:** 

**Rights/IP provenance, client-data segregation, secrets scan:** 

**Rollback / production impact:** 

**Independent reviewer (not PR author), owner and release approval:** 

Do not merge if a field is unknown and material to risk; mark it BLOCKED and create a tracked follow-up.
